propositions: templatefile() interpolates entire file as HCL template, treating shell comments as plain text and causing unescaped ${PARAMS} sequences to fail HCL parsing with 'Invalid character' at the ! operator

Three unescaped interpolation sequences in user_data.sh comments (lines 92, 92, 111) reference PARAMS bash array instead of declared template variable data_volume_id, breaking terraform plan execution
terraform plan blocks all operations on infra/terraform regardless of -target scope because configuration evaluation precedes target filtering, preventing workarounds
Regression introduced by commit ef1a7e66a65d which added explanatory comments with escaped first mention ($${...}) but left second mention unescaped (${...}), valid bash but fatal to templatefile()

Planned fix requires reworded comments avoiding unescaped ${}, regression guard script to validate templatefile() variable references, and live terraform apply to verify remote S3 state backend and SSM parameter adoption
